featured_reviews.review_text:
I request everyone to kindly not even consider visiting the Malad branch. Although I may have missed reading the exchange and return policy, unfortunately, I made a purchase from that store without checking the reviews, and that mistake on my part caused me a great deal of stress today due to the behavior of the manager.

When I stepped out of my house yesterday, I wore the footwear for barely five minutes, and I couldn’t even bear to walk in it. I immediately decided to return home and change into my formal sandal. When I went back to the store for an exchange, the staff did not even care to listen properly. Instead, the manager shouted at me continuously and behaved in a very rude and aggressive manner.

This message is specifically for the manager:

Your behavior can seriously affect someone’s mental health. When a customer spends ₹1500, and instead of calmly explaining the policy you refuse the exchange and shout at them, it is absolutely inhumane and unprofessional.let me tell you even 200 of purchase store would treat their customer nicely. This store will not remains too long, mark my word.Every platform gives their customer an exchange service.I was not demanded the return but an exchange sir.

Though after giving alot of stressed, he finally gave me an exchange like a begger. What a tactics sir hattoff.

I wish infuture someone really treat you the way you treated me today.

This is not a brand, but a customer scaming store.

featured_reviews.name: Swara Karle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish there was zero star option.This store is an absolute never visit for anyone looking for quality shoes or just shoes sandal. The owner’s attitude is terrible, and the shoes are just as disappointing. They sell cheap, low-quality shoes—barely worth 300 INR—for over 1300-1500 INR or even more!

They have a tiny sticker with “no exchange, no return” policy, so beware of that because they mean it. The salespeople are way too pushy and seem determined to make you buy something, regardless of your needs. I made the mistake of going in because it looked like a big store, without checking reviews, and it ended up being one of my worst shoe purchases.

I bought a pair in a hurry because my previous shoes broke, and I needed something fast. Unfortunately, I barely walked in them before realizing how uncomfortable they were. To top it all, they didn’t even last two months! Save yourself the regret and avoid this place.

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Khadke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi! 👋 I am Jayesh’s 11 yrs old daughter and I am very excited to be sharing this review!
We went to Bata shoe store 👟 at Vile Parle East and I must say that  it is an amazing and very high quality store with a large variety of amazing products, each with their own uses (workout, running, walking etc.) My family and I bought 4 pairs of shoes; 1 for my mom, 1 for my 6 yr old bro and 2 for me (none for my dad😜(he didn’t want, or need any)). For one of my pairs, there was a discount of 60%! These shoes fit me perfectly but we were hoping for something a bit bigger so that they will fit me in the future. Unfortunately, they didn’t have a bigger size and, since I liked those shoes a lot, we decided to buy the slightly small shoes and we left the store. Around 30-40 minutes later, we got a call from the store (We had given them our phone number) saying that they had found a bigger size in the same design! Can you believe it?! The employees decided to look for a bigger pair of shoes just for our satisfaction! So then we went back to the store, which didn’t take long because we were still out shopping, and traded the smaller shoes in for the bigger ones! In conclusion, the shoes all had reasonable prices and were certainly worth it. This shoe store is an awesome shoe store with great shoes and kind employees! Unfortunately, my family and I don’t live in India (we live in the Netherlands 🇳🇱 ), even though we are from India 🇮🇳 and we have family in India who we are currently visiting, so we won’t be able to come to this store a lot. That is why I, an 11 yr old girl, have taken the time to write this review on my dad’s phone. Thank you so much Bata shoe store for your amazing shoes and service!!!
